notes.title: V1.4.7 QOL PATCH
notes.content:
Commanders,

We've released a new patch to fix up some unbalanced aspects of the game, make the game a bit more fast paced, and scattered some extra eye candy across the board to make your game experience better!

Here's a list of all the changes below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41722444/ef6b5bfbc1ef0c84afcd34f9b03046a52c1d8782.png[/img]

[h1]v1.4.7 PATCH NOTES[/h1]

[h2]==VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS==[/h2]

Upgraded the visuals of Auroris. (Should now be a ton more trees floating around and frozen lakes to make the battlefield extra icy)

[h2]==NEW ENEMIES==[/h2]

[b]Enfreezinator ->[/b] An ancient shard ice of ice capable of freezing defenders outright with powerful blasts of magic. Appears on some levels after 3-6!

[h2]==BALANCE CHANGES==[/h2]

[h3]==ENEMIES==[/h3]

[b]Deathgripper -> [/b]
HP increased from 9000 to 9900
Explosion radius increased from 0 to 8
[i]We're seeing the Deathgripper be a bit too weak and unthreatening especially with its weaknesses to crowd control, so we're bumping up its tankiness and reducing its ability to be stalled.[/i]

[b]Diplomat ->[/b]
Buff CD increased from 0.12 seconds to 0.85 seconds
HP increased from 450 to 900
[i]We're noticing that Diplomats take a bit too less time to full kick in, especially on Invictus Mode, so we're giving the player more time to deal with them rather than forcing them to frontload all their defences.[/i]

[b]Colossus ->[/b]
Attack incrased from 46 to 55
[i]For a long time Colossus enemies have been jokes due to their stallability and slow speed. These changes should hopefully make it a bit more challenging to stall.[/i]

[b]Worm ->[/b]
Duplicates now have proper size
[i]Just a bug fix, unless you want tiny Worms...[/i]

[b]Bulldozer ->[/b]
Health increased from 355 to 515
[i]We're seeing the Bulldozer die a bit too quick especially after its shield has been broken. We're going to reduce its ability to be countered easily by bumping up its tankiness.[/i]

[b]Crusher ->[/b]
Health increased from 3150 to 3550
[i]Crushers are a bit too weak especially with their slow speed and instead remain punching bags for the player to destroy. Bumping up its health should make it a bit more threatening.[/i]

[b]Vexator ->[/b]
Health increased from 4400 to 4990
[i]With Vexators, we're seeing them get their HP bars popped a bit too easily especially later on, so we're gonna make them a bit more interactive and force the player to respond to them.[/i]

[b]Colosserdrill ->[/b]
Health increased from 17500 to 21000
Speed decreased from 0.36 to 0.33
[i]With Colosserdrills, we're noticing that their ignoring defenders makes it hard to fight off, forcing the player to use crowd control. We're rebalancing the enemy to skew it more towards damage and not requiring as much crowd control to counter.[/i]

[b]Ram ->[/b]
Health decreased from 900 to 650
[i]Rams are right now a bit too oppressive in the early game, making it unfair for the players to counter. Reducing health will make it slightly less annoying to deal with.[/i]

[b]Sapper ->[/b]
Health decreased from 1000 to 800
[i]Same with Sappers especially in early waves where energy is tight, shutting down the player's economy too often.[/i]

[h3]==DEFENDERS==[/h3]

[b]Barbarian ->[/b]
Health decreased from 135 to 125
Attack damage increased from 28 to 30
Cooldown decreased from 14 to 13 seconds
[i]We're seeing the Barbarian be used too often as a tank rather than a frontline attacker, so we're shifting its stats towards offence.[/i]

[b]Empyrean ->[/b]
Cooldown increased from 17 to 18 seconds
Speed increased from 1.5 to 1.56
Attack damage decreased from 40 to 38
Health decreased from 190 to 187
Burn stacks on hit decreased from 36 to 33
Heal p/second on shield trigger decreased from 20 to 18
[i]The Empyrean is right now a bit overtuned across all aspects, so we're trimming a few stats across the board to bring it in line.[/i]

[b]Executioner ->[/b]
Cooldown increased from 9 to 10 seconds
Health decreased from 230 to 215
[i]Same with Executioner, although as the Executioner is less well rounded we're going to give it a lighter nerf.[/i]

[b]Restorer ->[/b]
Cooldown increased from 55 to 60 seconds
Health increased from 250 to 300 
Attack damage decreased from 51 to 46
[i]Similar with the Restorer especially with using them as stalling rather than as healers, we're going to make it more punishing to lose a Restorer in the early game with increased CD.[/i]

[b]Paladin ->[/b]
Cooldown decreased from 36 to 31 seconds
Health increased from 460 to 475
[i]On the other hand the Paladin is significantly struggling especially on stages with high enemy count where it gets overwhelmed. We're going to reduce its downtime and give it a bit more health.[/i]

[b]Zapper ->[/b]
Cooldown decreased from 14 to 12 seconds
[i]The Zapper is very underused, often being used just for a 2 second stun. Going to give it reduced CD to ensure it has more use cases where an emergency stun may be helpful.[/i]

[b]Wall ->[/b]
Health increased from 113 to 116
[i]Same with the Wall with enemies getting more damage, although it should only lightly buffed due to its spammability. [/i]

[h3]==TOWERS==[/h3]

[b]Symmetria Crystal ->[/b]
Level 2 HP buff decreased from 25% to 20%
Level 3 Armor and MR increase decreased from 25% to 18%
Level 4 Heal p/second increased from 18 to 25 + 3% max health p/second
[i]We're going to shift the Symmetria Crystals' defenders buff to the later levels to incentivise players to upgrade it fully rather than keep it at Level 2 for the HP buff.[/i]

[b]Frostfire Laser ->[/b]
Energy cost adjusted from 10/12/14/16 to 13 flat
[i]Frostfire Laser is a bit underused apart from late game strats, so we're going to make it a bit stronger in energy tight levels.[/i]

[b]Purifier ->[/b]
Energy cost increased from 17 to 18
NEW attack projectile
Damage p/hit (PROJECTILE) increased from 13/16/23/34 to 30/38/51/72
Fire rate decreased from 3/4/5/6 to 2/2.3/2.6/3
Explosion radius increased from 1/2/3/6 to 6 flat
Projectile speed increased from 85 to 123
[i]We've patched up the Purifier to give its projectiles some more impact visually. The fire rate's been decreased to reduce lag, so damage should be increased so no DPS is lost.[/i]

[b]Frozen Shot ->[/b]
Attack speed increased from 0.25 to 0.27
[i]Frozen Shot right now has a bit too much downtime, and is basically useless unless upgraded, so we're going to give it a bit of its former glory back (but not too much so it doesn't permafreeze).[/i]

[h3]==BOSSES==[/h3]

[b]Cryonova ->[/b]
New tower freeze attack.
New attack where it'll encase itself in an ice shield.
Reworked AI on all difficulties to be more fair and predictable.
Phase 3 attacks now occur in bursts
Health decreased from 180000 to 150000
Enters phase 3 at 10/30% health instead of 20/40%
[i]Right now the Cryonova bossfight is a bit underwhelming and we're not really seeing the effect of the boss on the environment. We reworked the bossfight in a way that plays more into its ice environment and archetype.[/i]

[b]Overlord ->[/b]
Health increased to 100000 (200000 in Invictus mode)
[i]Overlord bossfight is lasting a bit too short right now so we're going to make it slightly longer[/i]

[b]Mrithus ->[/b]
Much less likely to use tower kill attack
Tower kill attack capped at 6 bullets
New Phase 1 theme
[i]Just a few improvements to the bossfight to make it much less RNG-based and way more intense.[/i]

[h3]==SPELLS==[/h3]

[b]Orbital Strike ->[/b]
Damage adjusted from 12% Max HP + 500-650 (450-525 for bosses) to 8% Max HP + 800 (1000 for bosses)
[i]Right now Orbital Strike is a bit too late game focused, with getting damage off on big enemies rather than clearing earlier waves. We're going to shift its damage more towards a helpful burst of damage rather than being spammed as "extra DPS"[/i]

[h3]==SYSTEMS==[/h3]

Slightly reduced the rate of inflation on Prestige and Invictus mode
Invictus and Prestige mode will feature slightly weaker and faster enemies than before 
Prestige and Invictus AOE penalty will no longer apply to enemy attacks

[b]Corrosion ->[/b]
Damage increased from 7 p/corrosion stack to 8 p/corrosion stack
[i]Corrosion stands very weak as a debuff, so we're going to increase its effect, which is an indirect buff to the Corrosive Shot.[/i]

[h3]==BUGFIXES==[/h3]

Frozen defenders should no longer be able to fight
Symmetria Crystal should now properly buff level 1 defenders.
Symmetria Crystal should now have a proper projectile
Burn effect will now play on every enemy that has burn stacks.
Range display is now much more visible

====================

[b]Thanks for continuing to play Cubelander!
[/b]
- Anthony
Hyperreal Games

notes.title: V1.4.6 QOL PATCH
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Just a small patch that fixes a few bugs + patch ups to a bunch of towers + defenders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41722444/ef6b5bfbc1ef0c84afcd34f9b03046a52c1d8782.png[/img]

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]

The Mrithus bossfight can now be completed properly
Missile Launcher Level 4 bullets no longer stun the enemy for 1 second.

[h2]IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

A lot of towers, defenders, and enemies have more sounds.

[h2]BALANCING[/h2]

[b]MRITHUS BOSS FIGHT[/b]
Void Obelisks can no longer be affected by Symmetria Crystal
[i](Developer's notes: This is to prevent the infamous Symmetria Crystal cheese where the player would take off 15% of a Void Obelisk's HP bar by using the tower.)[/i]

[b]OVERLORD BOSS FIGHT[/b]
Underlord's speed overclock now takes priority over slows
[i](Developer's notes: Slows are a bit too broken at dealing with Underlords, so this should hopefully make other strategies be considered.)[/i]

[b]TOWERS[/b]

[b]Symmetria Crystal ->[/b]
Energy cost increased from 2/4/6/8 to 8 flat
Fire rate decreased from 1.16 to 1.12
[i](Developer's notes: Once again, Symmetria Crystal's OP effect of causing a 15% stat loss should have significant drawbacks. This nerf is to bring it more in place.)[/i]

[b]Hot Shot ->[/b]
Burn points p/hit reduced from 6/12/17/25 to 6 flat
[i](Developer's notes: Making it harder to max stack burn with just 1-2 of these towers.)[/i]

[b]Hydra Cannon ->[/b]
Damage p/hit increased from 82/152/209/268 to 87/157/214/273
[i](Developer's notes: Hydra Cannon has been really... underwhelmingly lately. While we don't want to overbuff it due to it being very strong late game, we're going to give it some extra damage that should hopefully make its DPS more enticing.)[/i]

Sludge Cannon ->

Missile damage adjusted from 56/87/113/156 to 70/90/110/130
Sludge puddle damage p/second adjusted from 15/30/45/65 to 25/35/45/55
Energy cost reduced from 2/4/6/8 to 2/3/4/5
[i](Developer's notes: Sludge cannon, especially in the higher levels is a bit too broken, as it can provide both damage + crowd control at the same time, all for a very cheap price. At the same time, the early levels of Sludge Cannon are very weak currently, and players aren't really using them. These adjustments should hopefully put the tower in a better state.)[/i]

[b]DEFENDERS[/b]

[b]Executioner ->[/b]
Speed increased from 0.3 to 0.4
[i](Developer's notes: We're seeing the Executioner get mowed down by ranged enemies before it has a change to engage in combat. This speed bump should hopefully allow it to mitigate this.)[/i]

[b]Empyrean ->[/b]
Burn points on hit reduced from 42 to 36
Attack damage reduced from 44 to 40
Explosion radius reduced from 5 to 4
Health reduced from 195 to 190
[i](Developer's notes: Across the board, the Empyrean is a bit too strong, especially given its relatively low energy cost and cooldown. This nerf should hopefully bring it more into place, and make it less "a master of all stats")[/i]

[b]Restorer ->[/b]
Health increased from 245 to 250
[i](Developer's notes: Restorer is slightly weak right now, but we're not really too keen on buffing it excessively. Going to give it a slight HP bump.)[/i]

[b]Mage ->[/b]
Health increased from 65 to 70
[i](Developer's notes: Similarly here with the Mage, we're really seeing it struggle against enemies in combat. Even though it should be protected, we're going to give the defender a fighting chance against enemies in melee range.)[/i]

[b]Paladin ->[/b]
Health increased from 435 to 460
[i](Developer's notes: After the previous set of changes, the Paladin hasn't really seen much use, being overshadowed completely by the Empyrean. This HP buff should hopefully make it a viable alternative.)[/i]

_____________________________

Thanks for playing Cubelander :)

notes.title: V1.4.5 - ENTER THE EXECUTIONER
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41722444/af6b5dfdeb983d35c79c728baaa95ddc5fbb04f6.png[/img]

Enter a new defender, the Executioner.

+ A lot more fixes + QOL changes to improve your gameplay experience 

We haven't quit, v1.5 is in the works :)

- Anthony
Hyperreal Games

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41722444/ef6b5bfbc1ef0c84afcd34f9b03046a52c1d8782.png[/img]
[h2][b]NEW DEFENDER
[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Unlock the new defender, Executioner via the QUESTS panel!
[*] Deals heavy damage close up, causing targets to bleed health and have reduced healing.
[*] Attacks EXECUTE low health enemies, killing them instantly!
[/list]
[h2][b]MAJOR CHANGES
[/b][/h2][list]
[*] Towers no longer instantly deactivate when out of energy. You will now get a warning message, and only after will they shut down.
[*] Towers will no longer generate heat in Auroris if they are out of energy (Having an energy warning)
[*] Towers will freeze significantly faster when "OUT OF ENERGY"
[*] Added tooltips to many sections of the game
[/list]
[b][h2]BUG FIXES
[/h2][/b][list]
[*] Cores will now properly generate money and energy
[*] Burn debuff now properly deals damage.
[/list]
[b][h2]BALANCE CHANGES:
[/h2][/b]
[b][h2]SYSTEMS:
[/h2][/b]
[b]Burn ->
[/b]Damage increased from 24 + 140% burn stacks to 45 + 150% burn stacks
Burn stacks fall off 10 at a time instead of 7
[i](Developer's notes: Burn has been very weak, especially with towers such as Hot Shot and Empyrean being in a relatively poor state. Buffing its damage to make it more impactful.)[/i]

[b]Voidburn ->
[/b]Damage increased from 45-60 + 8% max health to 70-125 + 12% max health
[i](Developer's notes: We're not really seeing Voidburn have the impact, especially for a late game debuff. Making it more difficult for defenders to survive it.)[/i]

[b]Sandstorms ->
[/b]Last 9 seconds rather than 3 now
Damage type changed to Physical (from true)
No longer cause money loss
Increased damage by 10% to defenders
Damage dealt over 9 instances rather than at once
Applies a 90% slow to defender movement speed
[i](Developer's notes: Sandstorms are being reworked to make it more enjoyable to play against and so the player has more time to prepare)[/i]

[h3]TOWERS:
[/h3]
[b]Cube Beamer ->[/b]
Energy Cost increased from 1/1/2/2 to 1/2/3/4
[i](Developer's notes: Cube Beamer is a bit too strong, especially given early game energy is usually quite generous. Going to make it riskier to use it.)[/i]

[b]Cubic Tesla ->[/b]
Energy Cost increased from 5-7 to 7 flat
Damage decreased from 5/25/45/125 to 5/20/40/70
[i](Developer's notes: Cubic Tesla is similarly a bit too strong. Going to reduce its versatility to force you to use it in more niche cases)[/i]

[b]Frozen Shot ->[/b]
Range decreased from 32 to 30
Damage increased from 87/145/188/276 to 107/165/208/296
[i](Developer's notes: We're going to give Frozen Shot a buff as it really hasn't been packing the same punch as it used to)[/i]

[b]Gauss Accelerator ->[/b]
Fire rate decreased from 5 to 4.5/4.7/4.9/5
[i](Developer's notes: Early level Gauss Accelerators are becoming a bit too useful for its energy cost and price, so we're going to trim some power from them.)[/i]

[b]Purifier ->[/b]
Energy cost increased from 15 to 17
[i](Developer's notes: Purifier is once again becoming the dominant and meta tower for mid game stages. While we believe the Level 4 purifier is at a fair spot now, we're going to nerf its early game capabilities by making it more difficult to use in low energy situations.)[/i]

[b]Sludge Cannon ->
[/b]Explosion radius increased from 2/2/3/3 to 5 flat
Range decreased from 60 to 55
Sludge duration decreased from 3/3/4/5 seconds to 2/3/4/5 seconds
[i](Developer's notes: Sludge Cannon's slow has been a bit too broken with its infinite pierce, so we're going to shift away the power of the puddle and put it more towards the missile)[/i]

[b]Frostfire Laser ->
[/b]Slow adjusted from 50/68/84/99% to 60/70/80/90%
Slow duration decreased from 1 (applies every frame) second to 0.25 seconds
DPS increased from 90/185/310/380 to 100/195/320/390

[b]Symmetria Crystal ->
[/b]Fire rate decreased from 1.2 to 1.16
[i](Developer's notes: )[/i]

[b]Symmetria Sword ->
[/b]Slow duration decreased from 0.5 to 0.25 seconds
Slow adjusted from 12/25/38/50% to 33% flat
[i](Developer's notes: )[/i]

[b]Toxic Sentry ->
[/b]Energy cost increased from 2/3/4/6 to 3/4/5/8 
[i](Developer's notes: Toxic Sentry has been a bit broken lately, and we're going to increase the risk of deploying the tower.)[/i]

[b]Vaporiser ->
[/b]Energy cost increased from 3/4/6/9 to 10 flat
Ramping time increased from 3.75 to 3.85 seconds
NEW PASSIVE: Deals a bonus 125/250/375/500 DPS to bosses (remembering the Vaporiser is unable to lock onto bosses)
[i](Developer's notes: The Vaporiser has been a little bit too strong at targetting strong enemies, especially compared to other similar towers. It's also a bit too useless on boss stages, so we're giving it a little extra.)[/i]

[h3]DEFENDERS:
[/h3]
[b]Monolith ->
[/b]Health reduced from 1800 to 1750
Attack increased from 65 to 72
Death damage increased from 350 to 475
Slow on death increased from 80% to 86%
Slow duration increased from 3 to 4 seconds
Damage over time on death increased from 400 to 600 over 5 seconds
[i](Developer's notes: Balancing up the Monolith to make its highs less high and lows less low.)[/i]

[b]Titania ->
[/b]Cooldown decreased from 25 to 23 seconds
[i](Developer's notes: Titania has been a little on the weak side, especially with a very long cooldown. Going to fix this with a short CD buff)[/i]

[b]Zapper ->
[/b]Death damage increased from 150 to 175 
Disorientation time on death increased from 2.8 to 3 seconds
[i](Developer's notes: Zappers have been a bit weak and not seeing much use in many niches. Bumping up death damage to fix this)[/i]

[h3]ENEMIES AND BOSSES:
[/h3]
[b]Mrithus ->
[/b]
Upon spawning obeslisks for the third time in Invictus Mode, instantly does a tower destroy attack and a voidburn attack on defenders, and now heals to 100% health.
[i](Developer's notes: This is just for fun on Invictus Mode to throw one last challenge at the player!)[/i]

[b]Voidlord ->
[/b]
Health decreased from 63500 to 60000
[i](Developer's notes: Voidlords are a bit too hard to deal with when spawned near the exit. Going to strip a bit of health off it to make it easier to deal with)[/i]

[b]Worm ->
[/b]
Size increased
Attack damage increased from 35 to 26
Health increased from 355 to 400
[i](Developer's notes: Worms are a bit too squishy, being able to be killed quickly before they duplicate.)[/i]

[b]Diplomat ->
[/b]
Health decreased from 525 to 450
[i](Developer's notes: Diplomats have been incredibly unfun to play against, with them being too hard to kill when fully buffed.)[/i]

[b]Trojan ->
[/b]
Dash speed halved
[i](Developer's notes: With the new defenders being added, Trojans have been losing a lot of counterplay. Nerfing their dash speed to make them easier to deal with.)[/i]

notes.title: V1.4.4 QOL UPDATE
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Just a small patch tying up loose ends of v1.4.

v1.5 is in the works, thanks everyone for your patience!

- Anthony
Hyperreal Games

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41722444/ef6b5bfbc1ef0c84afcd34f9b03046a52c1d8782.png[/img]

[h3]VISUAL CHANGES:[/h3]

- Changed the Icon of the game while its running (Farewell to the 2021 Logo!)
- Changed the position of the Start Level button

[h3]GAMEPLAY CHANGES:[/h3]

- Voidlords can now spawn in Endless Mode

[b]In Endless Mode, reduced enemy scaling p/wave between Waves 50-75:[/b]
- Enemy Health p/round decreased from 8% p/wave to 6% p/wave
[i](Developer's notes: Now that the enemies in Endless Mode are stronger, we're going to slightly reduce the enemy stat scaling of earlier endless mode waves)[/i]

- Increased the speed limit cap for enemies in Endless Mode

[h3]BUGFIXES:[/h3]

- The spell button should no longer be visible before starting a level
- Hovering over the World Select Buttons should now properly cause them to glow
- The world images in World Select should no longer clip through the border

[h2]BALANCE CHANGES:[/h2]

[h2]TOWERS:[/h2]

[b]Cube Reactor ->[/b]
Cost increased from $175/300/450/625 to $175/350/525/750
Damage p/attack adjusted from 7/12/18/23 to 6/14/21/27
[i](Developer's notes: The increased cost to the Cube Reactor should hopefully allow us to balance it easier)[/i]

[b]Frostfire Laser ->[/b]
DPS increased from 60/160/285/375 to 90/185/310/380
[i](Developer's notes: Giving some power back to the Frostfire Laser, an early game-skewed buff that should hopefully reduce its reliance on its slow)[/i]

[h3]DEFENDERS:[/h3]

[b]Empyrean ->[/b]
Shield HP increased from 85 to 100
[i](Developer's notes: The Empyrean is still on the weakside and tends to get killed a bit too easily. We want to see the Empyrean taking on stronger enemies, and buffing its shield should allow for this more)[/i]

[b]Wall ->[/b]
Cooldown increased from 5.5 to 6 seconds
Health increased from 105 to 113
[i](Developer's notes: It's a bit clear we've overnerfed the wall in previous updates, with it not really be able to find a place. These adjustments should hopefully provide more incentive for players to use it now there are more alternatives to it)[/i]

[b]ENEMIES:[/b]

[b]Voidlord ->[/b]
Health decreased from 65000 to 63500
Speed decreased from 0.33 to 0.3
[i](Developer's notes: Giving the player more time to react to Voidlord spawns, especially if Void Obelisks are alive)[/i]

[b]Mite ->[/b]
Health reduced from 800 to 600
Speed increased from 1.8 to 2.1
[i](Developer's notes: Mites need to be more dangerous, especially being just HP tanks that aren't very threatening. Adjusting accordingly)[/i]

[b]ORBITAL STRIKE ->[/b]
Does not deal % health damage to bosses to avoid cheesing bossfights
Damage to bosses reduced from 500-650 to 450-525

notes.title: V1.4.2 Quality of Life Patch
notes.content:
We're back with some new changes that'll fix up some bugs in v1.4.1 and rein in some overpowered towers that are trivializing the game. 

As usual, if there's any other suggestions you have for us, or features you want us to add, feel free to reply to this post - we'll read every single message here! 

- Hyperreal Games

P.S. Changelogs are below, read them if you want.

_______________________________

[h3]Changelogs:[/h3]

[b]UI Changes:
[/b]

- The new update popup no longer appears for new players (They don't know what's going on!)

[b]Bugfixes: 
[/b]
- Fixed a bug where the Void Obelisk grants infinite money when destroyed
- Voidlord's laser should be more visible now 
- Removed a developer cheat code that could be accessed in game
- Cube Corp, Hydra Cannon, and Frozen Shot can now properly be obtained by completing their respective quests.
- It should no longer be possible to enter a battle without selecting any towers
- Player XP panel will properly display Level 100 as the max level.

[h3]Balance Changes:
[/h3]

[b]Towers:
[/b]
[b]Frostfire Laser ->[/b]
Range increased from 40/45/50/55 to 42.5/47.5/52.5/57.5
Burn points apply every 0.1 seconds rather than every frame
Burn points on hit increased from 2/3/4/5 to 7/8/9/10
Energy cost decreased from 10/14/18/22 to 10/12/14/16
[i](Developer's notes: The Frostfire Laser has been struggling after a round of heavy-handed nerfs in v1.3 designed to remove its 99% Level 1 slow, and after the burn rework, which removed even more utility from the tower. These changes should hopefully strengthen the tower, along with making a few fixes that helps game performance.)[/i]

[b]Hot Shot ->[/b]
Fire rate increased from 0.7/0.8/0.9/1.0 to 0.85/0.9/0.95/1.0
[i](Developer's notes: Similarly, the Hot Shot has been struggling to find relevance since v1.4, and has really been quite weak lately.)[/i]

[b]Missile Launcher (formerly Missile Base) ->[/b]
Projectile speed increased from 55 to 65
[i](Developer's notes: We're renaming the Missile Base into Missile Launcher for the sake of keep consistent with most tower defence titles.)[/i]

[b]EMP Field ->[/b]
Cost increased from $125/175/225/275 to $125/250/375/500
[i](Developer's notes: Our playtesters have discovered a strategy where you would place an EMP, let it attack, and then immediately upgrade it to reset the cooldown, and it's a bit too strong especially on Invictus Mode. [b]Ballista ->[/b]
Damage p/shot decreased from 24/49/69/87 to 24/47/66/83
[i](Developer's notes: Ballista could use some nerfs here and there, considering its widely overshadowing most other physical damage towers, and even the Purifier at times, given its 0 energy cost.)[/i]

[b]Defenders:[/b]

[b]Empyrean ->[/b]
Attack damage increased from 38 to 44
[i](Developer's notes: Empyrean... has been left VERY weak after the burn debuff nerfs along with Hot Shot and Frostfire Laser. We're going to similarly give it more damage to compensate.)[/i]

[b]Barbarian ->[/b]
Attack damage increased from 26 to 28
[i](Developer's notes: For a long cooldown defender, Barbarian is just... redundant? It doesn't really have the spammability of earlier defenders, and dies easily to stronger enemies.)[/i]

[b]Enemies:[/b]

notes.title: V1.4 UPDATE RELEASE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41722444/e2372eab9967501da637acea038a6444c6868dc4.png[/img]
[h1]Welcome to Update 1.4[/h1]

It's been almost a year since we've first released Cubelander. Felt like yesterday when we were making our menu music work, and enemies to move properly!

We've reworked the Mrithus and Overlord bossfights to involve a lot more void... and less lag. We've cooked up a new track to add to our OST as well and a new addition to your arsenal... 

In the meantime, enjoy the game!

[b]- Anthony Wu
Hyperreal Games[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41722444/ef6b5bfbc1ef0c84afcd34f9b03046a52c1d8782.png[/img]
[b]NEW DEFENDER -> Monolith
[/b]
- Extremely tough defender that violently explodes when killed
- Unlock by reaching Commander Level 90 in the QUESTS panel
- (TIP to farm XP: Playing levels and beating them on Invictus Mode grants HUGE bonuses of XP)

[b]NEW ENEMY -> Voidlord
[/b]
- Watch out for its deadly laser attack!
- Appears in the Geometric Void and summoned by Mrithus
- Extremely tough defender that takes many hits to bring down!
- Nigh-unstoppable when empowered by Void Obelisks!

[b]Small Changes ->
[/b]
- New BOSSFIGHT theme for Mrithus's Phase 2.
- Cores will no longer spawn a defender immediately when upgraded
- Autospawn rates have been reworked.
- Core regen rate now only 80% as effective as Normal on Prestige Mode and 60% as effective on Invictus Mode.
- Made Prestige and Invictus mode slightly easier, and adjusted some aspects of Normal Mode gameplay.
- You now gain XP for losing levels
- Commader XP for clearing waves in Endless Mode is now only granted for clearing waves above Wave 50. However, XP granted is significantly increased.
- You'll now need more XP in the earlier levels, less XP between levels 50-90 and more XP at levels about 90 to level up.
- Updated the Level Select UI and also credits UI
- Some enemies now have new FX!

[b]Bugfixes ->[/b]
- Adjusted the size of the freeze effect; it should no longer be too big for some enemies
- Unlock popups should no longer spawn on top of each other
- Final wave popup should no longer appear for Endless Mode
- Sell and build tower audio should now properly play when using hotkeys to upgrade
- Boss DR should finally be fixed -> was a bug with purifier dealing excessive damage to bosses
- Mrithus no longer has broken Phase 2 Behaviour
- Fixed twitching of price text when upgrading cores and towers
- Fixed enemies clipping across the map in Level 1-3
- Cube Corp, Hydra Cannon and Frozen Shot now correctly show up in Tower Select.
- Vaporiser now correctly deals 1% of DPS when not fully ramped up.
- Symmetria Crystal no longer grants 1 healing p/second at Level 1-3
- Towers now sell for full price before the game starts (so you can pick up and place towers before the game starts as needed!)
- Waves no longer get more dense as the level goes on in Prestige and Invictus Mode.

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[h3]Game Systems[/h3]

[b]==VOIDBURN DEBUFF==[/b]
- Voidburn debuff now deals 15-30 + 8% current health true damage p/second (from 25-50 magic damage p/second)
[i](Developer notes: For a final boss debuff, voidbuff has always felt a bit underwhelming, and especially against tankier defenders that would often not even be scratched. We're going to bump up the damage of Voidburn to deal max health damage to fix it.)[/i]

[b]==BURN DEBUFF==[/b]
- Burn debuff no longer applies slow or attack reduction. 
- Burn damage adjusted from 7 + (80% burn stacks) and 1.5 + (0.05 p/burn stack)% missing health physical damage to 24 + (140% burn stacks) p/second
- Burn damage no longer ignores 5% armor.
[i](Developer's notes: The burn debuff has always lacked clarity, decreasing attack and speed when players don't really expect it. We're going to remove those extra aspects, and compensate it by buffing its damage)[/i]

[h3]Towers[/h3]

[b]Symmetria Crystal ->[/b]

(NEW) Now deals 175/350/525/650 bonus true damage to boss units
Defender heal on/hit increased from 80% of damage on hit to 90% of damage on hit.
No longer applies a 20% slow on enemies for 1 second
[i](Developer's notes: Giving Symmetria Crystal some utility against bosses, and also making the tower more fun to use on defenders)[/i]

[b]Cube Launcher ->[/b]

Damage p/shot decreased from 12/24/48/72 to 12/23/45/69
[i](Developer's notes: Winding back a bit of Cube Launcher's damage, as the combination of range and price makes the DPS a bit too valuable.)[/i]

[b]Frozen Shot ->[/b]

Explosion radius decreased from 5 to 3
Post-freeze slow increased from 50% to 60%
[i](Developer's notes: Without making the Frozen Shot a better Cubic Tesla, we're going to buff it's stalling capabilities.)[/i]

[b]EMP Field ->[/b]

Recharge time increased from 10/9/8/7 seconds to 10/9.5/9/8.5 seconds
[i](Developer's notes: EMP Field is a bit too strong on Invictus strategies, and given it already provides instant damage upon upgrade, we think it's time to trim some stats elsewhere to put the tower in a more balanced state.)[/i]

[b]Purifier ->[/b]

Cost increased from $800/$1500/$2200/$3500 to $800/$1700/$2750/$4500
Energy cost increased from 10/11/12/13 to 15 flat
Only Laser DPS is buffed by Radar
[i](Developer's notes: We don't want the player to feel like the Purifier is the ONLY option for good DPS, and to run it in every loadout. We still wanted to preserve the thematic of the Purifier being an "Ultimate Weapon", but are going to make it significantly more risky for players to use it, especially on maps with less available resources.)[/i]

[b]Vapoiser ->[/b]

Ramping time decreased from 4 to 3.5 seconds
DPS increased from 700/1200/2100/3300 to 725/1250/2300/3650
[i](Developer's notes: Vaporiser's single target and backloaded DPS significantly hurts it, especially against strong and fast enemies. We're going to increase the Vaporiser's uptime and DPS to allow it better to slice through beefy enemies.)[/i]

[b]Hot Shot ->[/b]

Damage increased from 27/34/42/51 to 35/44/51/60
[i](Developer's notes: Hot Shot has essentially lost a lot of its utility following the Burn rework, so this will serve as a compensatory buff.)[/i]

[b]Cookie Oven ->[/b]

Cooldown adjusted from 6/6/12/12 seconds to 8 flat
Money p/interval adjusted from $20/28/75/125 to $30/45/65/100
[i](Developer's notes: Cookie Oven has felt a bit inconsistent to use, especially on Levels 3 and 4, where playtesters felt like the money generation intervals were completely random. This should hopefully fix it.)[/i]

[b]Energy Pylon ->[/b]

Energy p/interval increased from 10/15/20/25 to 15/21/27/33
Cost increased from $150/250/400/600 to $150/300/450/650
[i](Developer's notes: Given that energy can easily be generated via the Core, Reactor and Cube Corp, the Pylon is feeling a bit underwhelming, especially if used in conjunction with the Oven, taking up 2 slots. This change should hopefully make it more justifiable to spend a slot on energy generation alone.)[/i]

[b]Cube Corp ->[/b]

Energy cost removed
Energy p/interval decreased from 10/20/30/50 to 7/15/25/35
NEW: Maximum money p/interval now 100/200/300/500
NEW: Maximum energy p/interval now 70/150/250/350
[i](Developer's notes: On a similar vein, we're seeing Cube Corp overtake all other eco towers as the premier money generating tower on some maps. While we do like to see players optimise their setups to maximise income, on levels such as 2-9, the Cube Corp can trivialise levels. We're going to roll back its energy generation, and apply a cap to make its maximums less gamebreaking.[/i]

[b]Symmetria Sword ->[/b]

Energy cost reduced from 4 to 1
Smited now causes enemies to take 60/130/220/350% extra damage from defenders (from 60/120/200/300%)
[i](Developer's notes: We're seeing many defender users opt for the DPS of towers rather than use a slot for augmenting defenders. Going to reduce the risk of using the sword to sweeten the option of taking this tower!)[/i]

[h3]Defenders[/h3]

[b]Mage ->[/b]

Attack range increased from 25 to 30
Explosion radius increased from 2 to 4
Attack damage increased from 125 to 135
Recharge increased from 7 to 8 seconds
[i](Developer's notes: We're going to apply a buff to the Mage, as it has been often overshadowed by its more expensive counterparts.)[/i]

[b]Paladin ->[/b]

Health increased from 385 to 435
Attack damage decreased from 93 to 64
Explosion radius decreased from 6 to 4
Recharge increased from 33 to 36 seconds
[i](Developer's notes: We've been trying to give each defender a more unique and distinct role from each other. The Paladin will now be the tanker, and we're trading off a bit of its offensive capabilities, for increased survivability.)[/i]

[b]Empyrean ->
[/b]
Health decreased from 210 to 195
Attack damage increased from 35 to 38
Burn stacks on hit increased from 34 to 42
Shield now triggers from 30% health (from 33%)
Shield duration reduced from 5 to 4 seconds
Shield HP increased from 75 to 85
Heal p/second upon shield proc increased from 18 to 20 HP/sec
[i](Developer's notes: Similarly with the Empyrean, we're going to make the shield shorter but higher impact, so that it's good for surviving burst and less good for extended exchanges. We're also bumping up its DPS given the burn rework.)[/i]

[b]Restorer ->[/b]
Attack damage decreased from 61 to 51
[i](Developer's notes: Same with Restorer. Because it's already in a strong spot, we're going to trim its firepower to cement it more as a healing defender rather than a true damage DPS machine.)[/i]

[h3]Enemies[/h3]

[b]Cryonova ->[/b]

Health increased from 175000 to 180000
[i](Developer's notes: The Cryonova bossfight is lasting a bit shorter than we'd like to admit. We're going to apply a bit more tankiness to it.)[/i]

[b]Mrithus ->[/b]

REWORKED!

Phase 1 Health reduced from 250000 to 175000
Phase 2 Health reduced from 250000 to 180000
Time to complete Phase 2 increased from 5 to 8 minutes
Voidblobs now get faster as the battle continues on Prestige Mode and above
Get a huge burst of money, energy upon reaching Phase 2 (Resets inflation on Prestige Mode)
Now summons Void Obelisks on Phase 2 to heal and protect itself. Take down the void obeslisk to damage him!
Summons voidlords and empowers them through Void Obelisks in Phase 2.
Mrithus has reduced agressivity when void obelisks are alive.
Less likely to use tower destroy attack many times in a row
Start with more money and energy
[i](Developer's notes: Now, we've remade the Mrithus bossfight from the ground up. Phase 1 will largely be the same, but Phase 2 will introduce a new gimmick where you've got to down his Void Obelisks. They provide Mrithus with a shield and heal him overtime, so be sure to take them down fast!)[/i]

[b]Overlord ->[/b]

AI tweaked to prioritise spawning underlords if there are none alive. 
Less likely to use tower frier attack if no Underlords are alive.
On Invictus mode, will always buff nearby Underlords if more than 4 are alive at once.
Bullets now explode more violently.
Overlord speed buff now weaker, but lasts for longer
Tower fry attack now affects less tiles
[i](Developer's notes: These are just QOL changes so that the Overlord stops buffing Underlords when they are NONE alive!)[/i]

[b]Underlord ->[/b]

HP decreased from 8000 to 7200
New FX when buffed
Now immune to all slows  

[b]Voidling ->[/b]

Now heals and gains increased resistances when a Void Obelisk is alive
